title: QA Engineer I
jobDescription:
Role Overview:




We are looking for a highly motivated QA Engineer with 1 to 2 years of 
experience to join our growing team. The ideal candidate will work closely with 
the Amagi Onboarding Linear QA team to ensure high-quality Linear deliveries. 
You will be involved in all stages of Onboarding a Customer from reviewing 
requirements to executing tests, identifying defects, and suggesting 
improvements.




Key Responsibilities :


 * Review and analyse system specifications and requirements.
 * Develop and execute manual and automated test cases based on requirements 
and technical designs.
 * Identify, record, document, and track defects through testing tools.
 * Perform functional, regression, integration, and user acceptance testing.
 * Collaborate with cross-functional teams to ensure quality throughout the 
delivery lifecycle.
 * Support the creation and execution of automated test scripts and report 
results.
 * Communicate testing progress, issues, and risks to stakeholders in a clear, 
concise manner.
 * Assist in reproducing and isolating bugs and following up on resolutions.
 * Assist in developing and maintaining test documentation, including test 
plans, test cases, and user manuals.


Qualifications:


 * Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related 
field.
 * 1-2 years of experience in software quality assurance or testing.
 * Basic understanding of the software development lifecycle (SDLC) and 
testing methodologies.
 * Familiarity with bug tracking tools such as JIRA.
 * Experience with manual testing; exposure to automation tools like Selenium, 
JUnit, or Robot Framework is a plus.
 * Knowledge of scripting languages (Python) is an advantage.
 * Strong problem-solving skills and attention to detail.
 * Ability to work effectively in a team environment with good communication 
and interpersonal skills.


Nice to Have:


 * Knowledge on OTT, SSAI, Media Domain
 * Knowledge of CI/CD tools such as Jenkins.
 * Exposure to cloud platforms (AWS, GCP) and API testing tools (Postman).


 Join us and be part of a diverse team that values innovation and creativity. 
As a QA Engineer I, you will have the opportunity to make a meaningful impact 
on our products and customer experiences. If you are passionate about quality 
assurance and eager to learn, we encourage you to apply and embark on a 
rewarding career journey with us!

Role Overview:

The Business Development Representative (BDR) – Ads Business will play a 
critical role in driving outbound pipeline generation and strategic account 
development across regions. This role requires a highly proactive individual 
with strong outbound prospecting experience, understanding of the media and 
advertising ecosystem, and the ability to engage senior stakeholders across 
broadcasters, OTT platforms, agencies, advertisers, and FAST partners. You will 
work closely with Sales, Revenue Operations, Marketing, and Product teams to 
identify opportunities, generate qualified meetings, and contribute to Amagi’s 
advertising revenue growth.




What will you own?

1/ Prospecting & Pipeline Generation:


 * Identify and research high-potential accounts across regions within 
Broadcast, OTT, FAST, CTV, Advertising, and Media sectors.
 * Conduct outbound prospecting through email, calls, LinkedIn, and social 
channels to generate qualified opportunities.
 * Engage with senior decision-makers including Revenue Heads, Ad Sales 
Leaders, Digital Strategy teams, and Content Monetisation stakeholders.

Sales team.2/ Account Mapping & Market Research:

growth markets.

organisational structures.
 * Stay updated on regional media trends, advertising shifts, FAST ecosystem 
developments, and competitive landscape.3/ Campaign Execution & Sales 
Collaboration:

business objectives.

sequences, and vertical-specific positioning.
 * Contribute insights from prospect conversations to improve targeting and 
campaign effectiveness.4/ CRM & Operational Excellence:


 * Maintain accurate CRM hygiene and activity tracking within Salesforce and 
prospecting tools.
 * Ensure timely logging of prospect interactions, account updates, and 
qualification notes.
 * Provide structured handoff notes and qualification summaries to the Sales 
team.


What are we looking for?


 * Bachelor’s degree in Business, Marketing, Communications, or related field.
 * 5+ years of experience in Business Development, SDR/BDR, or Sales roles 
within SaaS, AdTech, MediaTech, Broadcast, OTT, or Digital Advertising 
industries.

markets.
 * Strong understanding of the media, advertising, OTT, FAST, or connected TV 
ecosystem.
 * Excellent communication, stakeholder engagement, and relationship-building 
skills.
 * Experience using Salesforce, LinkedIn Sales Navigator, Outreach.io, and 
modern prospecting tools.

high-growth environment.

 * Goodness Wins. We always lead with integrity.

title: Marketing Operations Lead (GTM - RevOps)
jobDescription:
Amagi is an AI-enabled industry cloud platform built for the new video economy, 
helping media companies modernize operations, unify streaming and broadcast 
workflows, and drive advanced monetization. From live remote production and 
real-time ad decisioning to automated playout and global content syndication. 
We operate a dynamic content and advertising marketplace and offer fully 
managed broadcast services that ensure 24/7 reliability and compliance. Trusted 
by 56% of the Top 50 media companies globally, Amagi powers over 7,000 channel 
deliveries across 300+ content distributors, processing 500K+ hours of content 
and generating 26 billion+ monetized ad impressions. Headquartered in 
Bengaluru, India, with a 1000+ member global team across Americas, EMEA and 
APAC, Amagi is redefining how media is created, distributed, and 
monetized—intelligently and globally.




Our identity and mission: Amagi, epitomizing the essence of freedom, embarks 
on an extraordinary mission to establish the world's foremost media technology 
business rooted in a foundation of goodness. Our commitment to autonomy is 
paralleled by our shared connection through a compelling purpose, with the 
Amagi Way serving as our guiding light. In our pursuit, we strive to create a 
harmonious blend of individual freedom and collective purpose, shaping a unique 
and transformative journey that sets us apart in the realm of media technology.




 Work Mode                  : In Office

 Location                       : Bengaluru (Bannerghatta Road)

 

Job Profile: 




Amagi is hiring a Marketing Operations Lead to own the systems, data, and 
automation that power our GTM engine. This is not a traditional MOps seat - it 
sits at the intersection of marketing operations and GTM engineering. You’ll 
run the full marketing-ops backbone (campaign ops, lead lifecycle, attribution, 
database hygiene) while building AI-native automations that eliminate manual 
work across Sales, Marketing, and RevOps. If you instinctively reach for a 
Claude + Clay workflow before a spreadsheet, this is your playground - and 
you’ll own the reporting layer leadership runs on, accountable for turning 
dashboards into decisions.

 

Key Responsibilities: 




Marketing Operations Ownership




Own the marketing-ops backbone: campaign operations, lead lifecycle, 
scoring/routing, attribution, and database hygiene across the funnel.

Administer HubSpot and Salesforce hands-on — objects, workflows, fields, and 
integration — keeping Salesforce as the single source of truth.

Drive SLA adherence and clean handoffs between Marketing, BDR/SDR, and Sales.




AI-Native Automation & GTM Engineering

Build end-to-end automations using a Claude + Clay combination plus n8n / 
Make to enrich, research, and act on data with minimal human overhead.

Stand up advanced enrichment and account-intelligence pipelines (ICP 
matching, contact/title enrichment, ABM, outreach automation).

Proactively identify automation opportunities; ensure workflows are scalable, 
fail-safe, and maintainable.




Reporting That Drives Outcomes

Own reporting and dashboards across HubSpot, Salesforce, and the GTM stack 
for stakeholders up to leadership.

Translate pipeline, campaign, and funnel data into actionable recommendations 
— and own the follow-through.

Use SQL (and Python where useful) to extract, transform, and analyze data 
across systems; run a 30-60-90 reporting cadence.




Cross-Functional Partnership

Partner with Sales, SalesOps, BDRs, PMM, and Leadership to turn business 
needs into scalable systems.

Document workflows and data flows, train the team, and support rapid 
deploy-measure-iterate experiments.




 

Skills and Expertise Required: 




AI-native operator: fluent in applying LLMs (Claude in particular) to design 
and ship real workflows — not just prompt occasionally.

Hands-on, advanced proficiency with HubSpot, Salesforce, and Clay (all 
must-have).

Proven ability to build automations with Claude + Clay and orchestration 
tools (n8n / Make); SQL for querying GTM data.

Reporting and dashboarding, with the judgment to turn data into action.

Strong grasp of GTM workflows: lead routing, scoring, ICP matching, ABM 
automation, attribution, and pipeline hygiene.




Competencies




Funnel & lifecycle ownership: govern lead lifecycle and stage definitions 
(Inquiry → MQL → SQL → Opportunity), scoring models, and routing rules.

Attribution & measurement: stand up and defend a campaign measurement and 
multi-touch attribution methodology tying activity to pipeline and revenue.

Campaign ops & data governance: own campaign setup, UTM/taxonomy, 
segmentation, QA, and database health (dedupe, normalization, enrichment, 
compliance).

Martech stack ownership: administer, evaluate, and rationalize the stack; 
manage vendors, renewals, integrations, and license/credit utilization.

Planning & stakeholder leadership: partner on target-setting and multi-BU 
campaign governance; drive cross-functional alignment on process, SLAs, and a 
single source of truth.




Good-to-Have

Python; warehouse / BI exposure (Databricks, Looker / LookML basics).

B2B SaaS GTM experience (post-IPO / high-growth); familiarity with Gong 
Engage, Outreach, or Swoogo.




Who You Are

AI-first by default: you reach for a Claude-powered workflow before a manual 
process and treat LLMs as core to how you operate.

Hands-on operator: equally at home building enrichment in Clay, configuring 
Salesforce and HubSpot, and reviewing pipeline with leadership.

A systems thinker with a bias for automation, strong ownership, and a 
builder’s instinct in high-growth environments.

You flag data-quality issues honestly rather than shipping polished-but-wrong 
output.




 

 

“Amagi is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate against 
applicants based on their gender, marital status, race, religion, color, age, 
capacity to work, sexual orientation, or status as a protected veteran.”

Role Overview:

We are looking for a Senior Manager – Procurement to lead strategic sourcing, 
vendor management, contract negotiations, procurement governance, and spend 
optimization across key technology and business categories.

This role will own vendor relationships across cloud, SaaS, telecom, 
hardware, and professional services, and will work closely with Business teams, 
Business Finance, Controllership, Legal, IT, and leadership to ensure 
commercially sound, audit-ready, and well-governed procurement decisions.

The ideal candidate should bring strong experience in managing high-value 
contracts, cloud and SaaS procurement, cost optimization, procurement MIS, 
stakeholder management, and contract lifecycle governance. This is a hands-on 
role that requires commercial sharpness, structured execution, strong 
follow-through, and the ability to build scalable procurement processes in a 
fast-paced environment.




What will you own?

1/ Strategic Sourcing & Vendor Management:


 * Own vendor relationships across cloud, SaaS, telecom, hardware, and 
professional services.
 * Manage relationships with key vendors including AWS, Azure, GCP, Linode, 
NetSuite, Salesforce, Workday, GitHub, Datadog, and other enterprise platforms.
 * Lead vendor evaluation, commercial discussions, renewals, escalations, and 
relationship governance.
 * Monitor vendor financial health and proactively flag concentration, 
dependency, or lock-in risks.2/ Contract Negotiation & Cost Optimization


 * Lead high-value contract negotiations from RFP to signature.
 * Identify and capture cost levers through competitive benchmarking, volume 
discounts, bundling, usage optimization, and commercial terms improvement.
 * Drive measurable cost savings through structured negotiation and 
disciplined commercial review.
 * Support renewal negotiations with data-backed recommendations and clear 
business cases.3/ Financial Analysis & Business Case Preparation


 * Run TCO analyses to support build vs. buy decisions and procurement 
recommendations.
 * Prepare ROI models, scenario analyses, and commercial comparisons to aid 
decision-making.
 * Prepare clear, factual, and decision-ready approval notes and business 
cases for executive sign-off.
 * Partner with Business Finance and Controllership to align on budgets, 
accruals, commitments, and spend governance.4/ Procurement MIS, Governance & 
Process Discipline


 * Build and maintain procurement MIS, including spend dashboards, savings 
trackers, SLA reports, and renewal calendars.
 * Share regular procurement updates with Finance and leadership.
 * Own the procurement action tracker, ensuring every active negotiation, 
approval, escalation, and contract review is logged and progressing as per SLA.
 * Build and enforce standard workflows including intake checklists, renewal 
tracking, parallel-action discipline, and PO/contract closure definitions.5/ 
Compliance, Controls & Documentation


 * Maintain audit-ready documentation across all contracts and procurement 
actions.
 * Ensure internal controls, approval processes, documentation standards, and 
audit trails are consistently followed.
 * Support internal audits by providing accurate documentation, process 
clarity, and evidence of compliance.
 * Review contracts from a commercial lens and identify clauses, risks, or 
gaps that require Legal review.


6/ Stakeholder Management & Team Enablement


 * Work closely with Business teams, Business Finance, Controllership, Legal, 
IT, and leadership to drive procurement decisions.
 * Ensure procurement actions are closed on time with strong follow-through 
and minimal chasing.
 * Support and mentor junior team members.
 * Build procurement playbooks, contracting templates, and repeatable process 
frameworks.


What are we looking for?


 * 8–10 years of experience in procurement, vendor management, or strategic 
sourcing, with meaningful exposure to high-value contracts.
 * Hands-on experience with at least one major cloud vendor such as AWS, 
Azure, GCP, or Linode.
 * Strong understanding of cloud pricing models, cost allocation, commercial 
management, and vendor governance.
 * Experience procuring complex hardware and enterprise SaaS platforms such as 
ERPs, CRMs, developer tools, security platforms, and business applications.
 * Proven track record of delivering cost savings through negotiation, 
benchmarking, and commercial discipline.
 * Ability to build procurement MIS and reporting from scratch, including 
spend dashboards, SLA trackers, renewal calendars, and executive summaries.
 * Experience in audit management, internal controls, documentation standards, 
and audit trail discipline.
 * Strong financial modelling skills, including TCO, ROI, scenario planning, 
and commercial comparisons using Excel or Google Sheets.
 * Comfortable reviewing contracts and identifying commercial risks, with the 
judgment to know when to involve Legal.
 * Strong partnership orientation with Business Finance and Controllership 
across budgets, accruals, commitments, and governance.
 * High ownership and follow-through discipline, with the ability to ensure 
SLAs are respected and actions are closed without repeated follow-ups
 * Experience in media, technology, SaaS, or product-led companies.
 * FinOps or cloud cost optimization experience.
 * Telecom or CDN vendor management experience.
 * MBA, Finance/Engineering degree, or procurement certification such as APICS 
or CPPO.
 * Familiarity with procurement tools such as SAP Ariba, Coupa, or NetSuite.

Job Profile : 

Amagi is seeking a motivated individual to join the Sales Operations unit 
within the Revenue Operations team. This role will lead key initiatives across 
sales efficiency, pipeline management, revenue planning, and forecasting to 
help improve sales productivity and drive business outcomes.




The ideal candidate has strong analytical skills, deep ownership, and 
experience with sales operations tools and processes—preferably within a SaaS 
or similarly structured company. A solid understanding of SaaS business models, 
execution discipline, and a track record of driving results in high-performance 
sales environments is essential.




Key Resposibilities :



1. Sales Operations & Planning


 * Partner with Sales Ops leadership to support forecast calls, sales capacity 
planning, territory design, and quota setting.
 * Help manage recurring planning cadences: quarterly target allocation, 
territory updates, and headcount ramp modeling.
 * Track quota attainment and provide early signals on over/under-performance.


2. Sales Productivity & Process Optimization


 * Identify friction points in the sales process and design process 
improvements to drive rep efficiency.
 * Maintain SOPs, workflows, and best practices that help scale global sales 
motions.
 * Support leadership in building a culture of operational rigor and 
accountability.


3. Forecasting & Pipeline Analytics


 * Collaborate with Revenue and Sales leaders to analyze pipeline health, find 
mechanism to improve forecast accuracy, and key metrics like win rates, cycle 
times, etc.
 * Build and automate dashboards and reports to improve visibility across geos 
and segments.
 * Spot gaps and risks before they become problems — and help teams take 
action.


4. CRM & Tools Management


 * Act as a power user and admin interface for Salesforce and other GTM tools 
(Clari, Outreach, etc.).
 * Own data hygiene, pipeline integrity, and enforce discipline around CRM 
usage.
 * Work with cross-functional stakeholders to implement and improve workflows 
within our tech stack.


5. Incentives & Deal Desk Support


 * Assist in calculating and communicating incentive payouts based on approved 
plans.
 * Support deal desk operations by reviewing high-value opportunities and 
ensuring compliance with deal guidelines.
 * Help design commissions tracking systems and escalation paths for 
exceptions.


6. Channel Operations


 * Define and manage the process for channel partners to track the leads, 
pipeline and revenue outcomes from channel partners in a system driven fashion 
 * Build mechanism to track invoices, credits, approvals and payout from 
cloud, technology, service partners for the right accounts and regions with a 
monthly cadence. 


7. Collaboration & Enablement


 * Work closely with cross-functional teams like Marketing, Customer Success, 
and Finance to ensure alignment across the funnel.
 * Contribute to onboarding and training of new sales hires by providing 
process, system, and performance data insights.
 * Be a partner in enablement initiatives by making sure reps have what they 
need to succeed — playbooks, workflows, templates, and tech.





Skills and Expertise Required: 


 * 3–6 years of experience in Sales Operations, Revenue Operations, or 
Strategy roles, ideally in a high-growth SaaS or B2B tech environment.
 * You know your way around Salesforce like a local. Bonus points if you've 
worked with Clari, Outreach, or other GTM tools.
 * Strong analytical chops — you love digging into data and pulling out 
insights that drive decisions.
 * Process-oriented mindset with the ability to take ambiguous business needs

title: Manager - Program Management
jobDescription:
About Amagi

We are a next-generation media technology company that provides cloud 
broadcast and targeted advertising solutions to broadcast TV and streaming TV 
platforms. Amagi enables content owners to launch, distribute, and monetize 
live linear channels on Free Ad-supported Streaming TV and video services 
platforms. Amagi also offers 24x7 cloud-managed services bringing simplicity, 
advanced automation, and transparency to the entire broadcast operations. 
Overall, Amagi supports 700+ content brands, 800+ playout chains, and over 2500 
channel deliveries on its platform in over 40 countries. Amagi has a presence 
in New York, Los Angeles, Toronto, London, Paris, Melbourne, Seoul, Singapore, 
and broadcast operations in New Delhi, and an innovation center in Bangalore. 
For more information visit us atwww.amagi.com <http://www.amagi.com/>

 

Role: Manager - Program Management

Location: Bangalore

Department: Program Management

 

Amagi is seeking an experienced Manager - Program Management (TPM) to lead 
the planning, execution, and delivery of critical technical programs for 
enterprise customers. As a TPM, you will leverage ametrics-driven approach to 
ensure that projects are completed on time, within scope, and with the highest 
quality. You will also collaborate extensively with both internal teams and 
onsite customer-facing project management and technical teams, ensuring 
seamless communication and successful program execution.

This role requires a deep understanding of product functionality, strong 
technical expertise, and the ability to translate customer needs into 
actionable plans. You will use your ability to manage by data, deliver 
strategic insights, and guide cross-functional teams to achieve program goals.

 

Key Responsibilities:

1. Program Planning & Execution Excellence

·       Detailed Planning: Lead the creation of comprehensive, actionable 
plans for all technical programs, defining scope, schedule, and quality 
metrics. Ensure that all program milestones, including feature releases, defect 
resolutions, and customer deployments, are meticulously planned and tracked.

·       Metrics-Driven Execution: Manage program performance using 
quantitative metrics such as project timelines, resource allocation, issue 
tracking, and customer satisfaction scores. Use data to inform decision-making, 
proactively identify risks, and adjust plans when necessary.

·       Risk & Contingency Planning: Identify potential risks early in the 
planning phase, develop mitigation strategies, and maintain a risk register to 
ensure timely action.

·       Predictability & Transparency: Ensure predictability in program 
delivery by consistently monitoring and reporting progress against plan. Keep 
stakeholders updated on status, risks, and decisions using clear, transparent 
communication.

·       Rigorous Scope Management: Ensure strict control over project scope, 
with formal sign-off via a scoping document before any development starts. 
Track and manage any changes through a formal Change Request (CR) process.

·       Metrics-Driven Change Control: Assess the impact of scope changes 
using metrics to quantify their effects on timelines, resources, and budgets. 
Communicate changes to all stakeholders, ensuring alignment and tracking of 
adjustments.

·       Customer-Facing Defect Management: Track and prioritize Customer 
Found Defects (CFDs) based on agreed-upon SLAs, ensuring clear reporting and 
transparent communication with customers.

 

2. Enterprise Customer Management

·       Voice of the Customer: Act as the primary advocate for the customer, 
ensuring their needs and priorities are embedded in program planning and 
execution. Communicate any impact on customer deliverables promptly and 
transparently.

·       Customer-Focused Metrics: Track and report key customer satisfaction 
metrics, escalations, and defect resolution progress. Use insights from these 
metrics to continuously refine delivery processes and customer interactions.

·       Roadmap Alignment & Communication: Ensure the technical program 
roadmap aligns with the broader product roadmap. Collaborate with product 
management and customer success teams to balance customer expectations with 
product capabilities, using data to manage trade-offs.

 

L2 Handover & Post-Launch Support

·       Seamless L2 Handover: Ensure that key milestones (e.g., channel 
launches, upgrades, infrastructure changes) are followed by timely and complete 
L2 handovers. Track actions and ensure that they are completed within 
agreed-upon timelines.

·       Post-Launch Monitoring: Collaborate with Customer Success and onsite 
technical teams to monitor program performance post-launch, addressing any 
issues or customer concerns promptly.

 

3. Stakeholder & Cross-Functional Collaboration

·       Cross-Functional Collaboration: Collaborate closely with onsite 
customer-facing project management teams and technical teams to ensure 
alignment between customer needs and internal execution. Build strong 
relationships with these teams to ensure smooth communication and efficient 
problem-solving.

·       Joint Stakeholder Management: Partner with customer-facing teams to 
align on key milestones, risks, and customer priorities. Ensure that all 
stakeholders—internal and external—are kept updated on program status through 
clear, consistent communication and reporting.

·       Unified Escalation Management: Work collaboratively with onsite teams 
to identify potential escalations early and address them proactively. Manage 
escalations jointly, ensuring timely updates and resolutions for customers.

·       Clear Communication: Establish transparent and effective 
communication channels with all internal and external stakeholders. Ensure that 
program plans, milestones, risks, and issues are clearly communicated to all 
parties using data to guide decision-making.

·       Internal Alignment: Collaborate with internal teams (Product 
Management, Engineering, QA, etc.) to ensure customer priorities are reflected 
in the technical execution of the program. Use metrics and data-driven insights 
to keep internal teams aligned and accountable.

 

 4. Program Metrics & Reporting

·       Regular Reporting: Own the creation and maintenance of program 
dashboards and metrics to provide clear visibility into project health. 
Regularly update stakeholders on key performance indicators (KPIs) such as 
scope adherence, schedule performance, defect resolution, and customer 
satisfaction.

·       Impact Measurement: Define and track success metrics for the program. 
Ensure that KPIs such as on-time delivery, quality assurance, and cost control 
are consistently met.

·       KPI-Driven Decision Making: Use program metrics to make informed 
decisions about resource allocation, scope adjustments, and risk management. 
Regularly evaluate the success of program elements based on measurable outcomes.

 

5. Continuous Improvement

·       Process Refinement: Continuously assess the effectiveness of 
planning, execution, and reporting processes. Identify opportunities for 
improvement and implement changes that enhance the program’s efficiency and 
success.

·       Feedback Loops: Establish strong feedback loops with both internal 
and customer-facing teams to capture lessons learned and incorporate them into 
future program planning and delivery.

 

Product & Technical Expertise

Product Knowledge

·       Operational Understanding: Gain deep familiarity with AMAGI products, 
ensuring you can understand and leverage product features in common use-cases. 
You should be able to operate the product like an experienced user, 
understanding how each feature supports customer workflows.

·       Customer-Centric Use-Cases: Identify common use-cases and pain points 
that customers experience, ensuring that the technical program is aligned with 
their needs and expectations.

 

Technical Understanding

·       High-Level Architecture: Demonstrate a strong understanding of 
software product’s technical architecture, including how product components 
interconnect to fulfill common use-cases.

·       Deployment & Architectural Diagrams: Be able to explain deployment 
and architectural diagrams for customer sites, showcasing how product 
components work together and how they are implemented in different environments.

·       Product Functionality: Be able to walk through product components, 
explaining their roles in customer workflows and how they interact to deliver 
value.

 

Success Criteria:

·       Adherence to Plan & Metrics: Ensure all projects stay on track with 
predefined plans and KPIs. Any deviations should be identified and addressed 
early with corrective actions taken.

·       Scope Control: No scope creep occurs without formal approval, and all 
changes are tracked and communicated with clear impact assessments.

·       Schedule & Cost Management: Ensure projects are delivered on time and 
within budget, with any delays or cost increases being managed through 
proactive mitigation plans.

·       Quality Assurance: Ensure that critical bugs are not shipped without 
exception approvals and that CFDs are tracked and resolved within SLAs.

·       Customer Satisfaction: Maintain strong customer relationships and 
consistently meet satisfaction targets through clear communication and timely, 
high-quality delivery.

·       Reporting & Communication: Deliver regular, actionable reports on 
program health and metrics, meeting internal and external stakeholder needs.

 

Required Qualifications:

·       Experience: 5+ years in Technical Program Management, with a strong 
emphasis on planning, metrics management, and customer-facing collaboration.

·       Education: Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or 
related field. PMP, Agile, or similar certifications are a plus.

·       Technical Expertise: Strong understanding of technical program 
delivery in SaaS or enterprise environments. Familiarity with CloudPort’s 
architecture and components is a plus.

·       Cross-Functional Collaboration: Proven ability to collaborate with 
onsite customer-facing project management and technical teams to ensure 
alignment and successful delivery.

·       Data-Driven Management: Strong ability to manage projects using 
metrics, KPIs, and dashboards to drive decision-making and optimize execution.

·       Communication Skills: Excellent communication skills, including the 
ability to translate technical concepts into understandable language for 
non-technical stakeholders.

 

Preferred Qualifications:

·       Industry Knowledge: Familiarity with media, broadcasting, or cloud 
technology industries.

·       Agile Methodology: Experience with Agile methodologies and tools like 
Jira for project tracking and reporting.
